problem_type: The storyboard side (renderer document plans and the storyboard editor) carried its own copy of two semantics the host had already fixed: it placed the frame ratio only on a control literally keyed aspect_ratio, and it replaced a shot's parameters wholesale on revision
symptom: A film-level 16:9 set in the storyboard editor is dropped on shots whose model calls its ratio size (Z-Image) or ratio (Agnes); the bulk bar marks those shots unsupported; Runway pixel-size controls drop the value. Agent revisions of a document-plan shot reset every other parameter.
direct_cause: buildPlannedNodeMeta only accepted params whose key equals a control key, and FILM_DEFAULTS writes the ratio under aspect_ratio; unsupportedFilmDefaultKeys judged support by the literal key; projectShotNode's unchanged-model branch wrote aspect_ratio raw into node meta; patchStoryboardSubject set params to patch.parameters.
class_root: One semantic, two implementations: the host owns ratio translation and merge-patch semantics, the storyboard side re-implemented both with the simplest local rule.
affected_population: Storyboard editor plans whose shots use a model whose ratio control is not keyed aspect_ratio or offers pixel sizes
entry_points: Storyboard editor -> materialize / write back -> resolveShotParams -> buildPlannedNodeMeta or projectShotNode
Agent draft_shots on a document plan -> patchStoryboardAuthoring -> renderer patchAgentStoryboardDesign -> patchStoryboardSubject
Agent draft_shots creating a document plan -> storyboardPlanFromDraftSubjects -> storyboardSubjectFromCandidate
internal_only_reason: Merge semantics follow RFC 7396 and the ratio vocabulary follows the AI SDK convention (both cited in the design card); the invariant is Nomi's own single-source rule between host and storyboard code.
invariants: Every path that writes a storyboard shot's parameters onto a canvas node translates the ratio intent with placeAspectRatio from electron/shared/aspectRatioValue.ts.
The bulk bar reports a film-level value unsupported only when placeAspectRatio cannot place it on that shot's mode.
Inside a storyboard plan a shot's ratio lives only in params.aspect_ratio.
Revising a shot's parameters, on the host or in a document plan, goes through mergeNamedParameters.

invariant_owner_layer.why: The ratio judge already serves the host since #1023; the storyboard landing, write-back and bulk bar now call the same placeAspectRatio. The merge rule lives in electron/shared/generationParameterPatch.ts and is covered by generationPlanPatchMerge.test.ts and the matrix test.

door_reduction.why_not: Three distinct consumers: plannedNodeMeta is the single node-landing write boundary (three landing paths share it), storyboardProjection writes back to an already-landed node when the model did not change, storyboardShotScope answers the bulk bar. Each now calls the one judge instead of its own literal-key rule.

generality_proof: The judge is chosen by option set, not key name, and is the one the host uses; the matrix test drives six real profiles (size, aspect_ratio, ratio, pixel sizes, no ratio choice) through landing, write-back, bulk bar and document revision. The census from #1023 bounds the catalog: 336 combinations, none with two ratio controls.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Place the ratio intent (storyboard slot or semantic key) on the mode's real ratio key and option value, or report it unsupported.
Merge named parameters into stored ones, null removes a key.
Keep a storyboard shot's ratio in the single aspect_ratio slot when authored or revised.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Matrix test section 1 lands six profiles.
Advisory only: it feeds resolveGenerationPlan for merge/split suggestions and never writes parameters to a node or request.

recurrence.reason: Every model whose ratio key is not aspect_ratio and every document-plan revision reaches it.
same_class_scan: git grep -n "key === 'aspect_ratio'" src electron (only the deleted aspectControlOf)

prevention.invariant: Ratio placement and parameter revision each have one shared implementation used by host and storyboard.
prevention.failure_mode: A ratio that cannot be placed is omitted from the node and reported unsupported in the bulk bar; nothing is sent under an unknown key.
prevention.strategy: Route the storyboard's three ratio consumers and its revision merge through the shared functions; delete the literal-key judges.

legacy_paths.rationale: Deleted the literal-key aspectControlOf (no production caller), the literal-key support check in unsupportedFilmDefaultKeys, and the wholesale params replacement in patchStoryboardSubject.

migration: No data migration. Document plans created by the agent after #1023 may hold the ratio under the model's real key; they keep landing correctly (the real key is a valid control value) and are folded into the slot the next time the agent revises their parameters.
residual_risks: Keyframe write-back when the model did not change resolves the mode from node meta; nodes without archetype identity keep the raw slot value (same as before).
The advisory strategy resolver still sees the aspect_ratio slot key.
Real App acceptance is unverified in this line.
